messages:
Sam: Quick async status on dedicated capacity buildout + 3 small asks. TL;DR: procurement bridge plan looks feasible but we have two reservation gaps (zone-a, zone-c) and a routing/fallback config that needs owner + a short PR review.

Sam: Procurement update: vendor confirmed staggered H100 shipment - 12 units arriving week of 2312400000, 20 units week after. Still waiting final ASN for the 12. If ASN slips, we need to trigger the temporary bridge nodes (see below). :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sam: Capacity reservations: current reserved capacity covers 75% of expected throughput. Gaps: zone-a missing 8 GPUs, zone-c missing 6 GPUs. That maps to two customer reservation rows in the spreadsheet (link: https://docs.redwood.ai/ramps/2023-dedicated-slate).

Sam: Bridge proposal (temporary): borrow 10 mixed A100->H100 backfill nodes from staging pool for 2 weeks. These will be behind a routing policy labeled `bridge-temp` and routed only for non-prod or burst traffic. Need owner to approve and a fallback policy that demotes to smaller model if load continues.

Sam: Ask 1 - Ownership: who owns the bridge routing policy + eviction criteria? want a named owner to add to runbook. Ping @Jess for infra ownership, @Rahul for network constraints.

Jess: I can own the bridge routing policy + can implement eviction hooks. Need to confirm power/cooling headroom in zone-a before we commit to bridging more nodes there. I asked infra-ops for a quick readout. :white_check_mark:

Rahul: network note - zone-c has a VLAN carve (vlan-37) reserved but the cabling lead time is 5 business days. We can do the temporary nodes in zone-b if that helps, but will need updated routing table and NAT rules. I can do the NAT updates if Tony signs off on the VLAN change.

Maria: SRE concerns: traffic shaping + burst policy should include a hard rate limit for per-customer qps to avoid noisy neighbor. Can we add a per-tenant token bucket? Also we should enable prefix KV cache warming for the bridge to avoid cold-start token spikes.

Sam: Ask 2 - Can someone post the autoscaler tweak we need? I sketched a small change to the scale-down grace and maxSurge in the infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482

Sam: snippet I suggested:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  maxSurge: 4
  scaleDownGraceSeconds: 180
  nodeSelector:
    gpu.type: h100
```
Please comment inline if that looks dangerous.

Tony: Reviewing the PR now. Quick flag: maxSurge 4 is OK for zone-b but in zone-a with limited power we should keep maxSurge=2 until we confirm headroom. Jess please confirm power before we land.

Jess: Confirmed with infra-ops: zone-a headroom only supports 2 extra nodes right now. I'll attach the heat map to the PR in a bit.

Sam: Ask 3 - Code review: @Tony & @Rahul can you PTAL on https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482? I left two TODOs about fallback routing and NAT rules. Need approvals to merge by EOD PST so we can trigger the bridge tomorrow morning if ASN slips. :eyes:

Tony: Will review before lunch. If we need to delay, propose we flip the routing to prefer dedicated but allow `burst-pool` failover with a 10s de-prioritize window. That gives graceful degradation.

Rahul: I can rubber-stamp the NAT changes once Tony confirms the routing. One question: do we need additional firewall rules for the bridge nodes? If they use staging images they might require different SSH jump host rules.

Maria: Ops checklist addition: please add steps for cache warming, per-tenant qps limits, and an immediate revert plan if tail latency > 200ms for 3m. I can paste the snippet to the runbook.

Sam: I'll update the runbook with Maria's items and mark the PR as blocking the bridge action. If we get approvals, plan: merge PR -> land NAT/routing -> schedule canary traffic 15m later -> monitor traces/latency for 30m -> promote.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2312347200 for route `bridge-temp` with traffic ramp 5%->25% over 15m. Runbook link: https://playbooks.redwood.ai/dedicated/bridge-canary

Jess: added heat map + power headroom note to PR. :thumbsup:

Tony: Reviewed and left a few small comments. Setting maxSurge=2 for zone-a and 4 for zone-b via overrides. Approving once comments addressed.

Rahul: NAT rules applied to staging VLAN. Will apply to bridge namespace after merge.

Sam: Thanks all. Final ask: owners, please drop a one-line ack here when you've done your action (approve PR / confirm NAT / add runbook bits). I want a clear trail for the postmortem if ASN slips.

Jess: ACK - will confirm power + approve PR after heat map check.

Tony: ACK - comments addressed, approving after Sam updates the few variable names.

Rahul: ACK - will apply firewall/NAT post-merge.

Maria: ACK - runbook updated with cache and SLO checks.

Sam: Great. If anyone hits a blocker, call me or drop in #eng-oncall. I'll ping infra-ops for ASN follow-up. :phone:

Sam: (added) If we don't hear vendor ASN by 2312348000 I'll flip the bridge switch manually at 09:00 PST next day.

Sam: Closing thread for async, will re-open if something changes.
